# Vendored JS

Static copies, pinned by version in the filename. No CDN at runtime.

| File | Library | Version | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `htmx-2.0.11.min.js` | htmx | 2.0.11 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/htmx.org@2.0.11/dist/htmx.min.js |
| `alpine-3.17.4.min.js` | Alpine.js | 3.17.4 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/alpinejs@3.17.4/dist/cdn.min.js |
| `chart-4.5.1.umd.min.js` | Chart.js | 4.5.1 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js |

To upgrade: download the new file, rename it with the new version, update `base.html` and this table.
